text: This report provides an overview of the activities of the Fair Wage Office for 2017.

The Government Management Committee: 1. Requested the Manager, Fair Wage Office to review the process for sharing information and providing education about the Fair Wage Policy to determine whether there may be more effective ways to inform employees, businesses and the public about the policy and the complaint process, and report to the Government Management Committee prior to the 2019 budget process on any possible changes or improvements, and any additional resources required.
